Save this video before the program caps, and follow The Model Verse for daily developer perks. Get your stack before the window closes!

step_by_step_application: 1. Visit fin.ai/learn/ai-credits-for-startups for verified provider application routing.
2. Apply at claude.com/programs/startups for $1,000 direct Claude API credits + 1 yr Claude Team.
3. Sign up for Groq and Deepgram developer tiers for zero-cost model testing without credit cards.
4. Join NVIDIA Inception to unlock $7,500 in Lambda Labs GPU cloud compute.
5. Activate Fin Startup Pack for 1 free year of AI agent application layer.
perk_metadata.anti_hallucination_notes: AI model credits (Anthropic/OpenAI) cover inference tokens. Compute credits (Lambda/AWS) cover VMs and GPUs. Application layer credits (Fin) cover customer service agents. Stacking across layers provides up to $100K in total runway without diluting equity.
